coupling_categories.description: Main MCU and SBC watchdog share supply rail (SBC supplies MCU)
coupling_categories.impact: Common-cause supply failure disables both main path and watchdog detection
coupling_categories.independence_argument: Independent monitor (FB2-HW-TSR-000004) uses separate comparator with own reference; not supplied by SBC
coupling_categories.residual_risk: Supply coupling accepted; monitor rail separation specified in HSI

coupling_categories.description: SOA task and contactor task run on same MCU with same RTOS
coupling_categories.impact: RTOS scheduling fault could delay both detection and reaction
coupling_categories.independence_argument: None within MCU - covered by independent HW monitor path
coupling_categories.residual_risk: Managed via external monitor; FFIO analysis FB2-SAF-ANL-000004

coupling_categories.description: Main AFE path and independent monitor both connect to cell voltage tap
coupling_categories.impact: Connector failure at cell tap removes both voltage sensing paths
coupling_categories.independence_argument: Separate tap points and separate harness for monitor (design constraint in FB2-HW-TSR-000004)
coupling_categories.residual_risk: Documented; harness separation is HW design constraint
